notes.title: 2025 Classes Game Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25580675/59ac55f8067bd85c763f201d88a49e2347c01a5e.jpg

The Zezenia Online 2025 Classes Update has been released! Steam users may need to restart the Steam app to trigger the update.

Widescreen View

Zezenia has come a long way since the time Windows XP was the latest and greatest and 4:3 monitors were common. It's time to experience Zezenia from a new point of view with the Widescreen Update, which stretches the game area to a more immersive aspect ratio!

Minimap Icons Update

The ingame World Map has received a vibrant update with revised minimap icons that fill in previously missing areas and introduce new types of markers. Enjoy enhanced visibility with higher contrast icons and make use of a wide selection of new icons, making your navigation easier than ever!

Character Builder

Explore the vast array of outfits, hairpieces, beards, and accessories available in the updated Character Builder! It has been never easier to make your character truly your own.

https://download.zezeniaonline.com/images/2025-07-character-builder.webp

Party & Hunt Analyzers

Take your hunts to a more scientific level with the newly added Hunt & Party Analyzers! Whether you are hunting by yourself or in a party, the analyzers calculate your profits in a hunt automatically. Data for each session can also be copied to the clipboard in a standard format for further processing.
https://download.zezeniaonline.com/images/2025-07-hunt-analyzers.webp

Balance Changes

This update marks the beginning of a new balance in Zezenia Online. The changes made are based on feedback solicited through private Focus Group and public community feedback. Our aim has been to buff classes that need it the most while addressing late game power creep for long term longevity of the game. While most changes add to the game, we believe that some nerfs must be made.

Health Steal & Dodge Formula Updates
- Health Steal has been updated to cap excessive, balance breaking amounts of health steal. The updated calculation is based on the damage accumulated across all tiles and the player's total health, ensuring that a single combination can no longer fully heal a player.
- Dodge has been updated to cap excessive amounts. The new calculation is based on the player's Defending skill and Dodge from stats.

However, this is not the end but merely the beginning of a new Class Balance. By considering all the collected feedback we will be able to define the unique future of each subclass to come. By working on the foundation set today we can get back to delivering regular updates and new experiences to you.

Shaman's Beast Call

Shaman's Beast Call spell ascends to a new level with the Summon Tank, a fierce beast to aid the party in battle. The tank charges targeted foes with melee and spell attacks, healing the party at a constant rate. Each summon lasts for 35 seconds, after which it casts a damage over time curse on nearby enemies.

Beast Call Name Contest Results

The staff would like to thank all participants who took part in the Beast Call Name Contest. After a meticulous process of validation, evaluation and elimination to disqualify duplicate and inappropriate entries the fair winners have been selected! We are happy to introduce the Beast Call summon Varnok.

https://download.zezeniaonline.com/images/2025-08-name-contest-winner.jpg

The Emerald Watcher. A mutated creature from the Forests of Xavark, born from ancient magic and a primal beast spirit. His glowing green eyes see the flow of mana, and he guards forgotten portals with unstoppable rage.

The winning entry was submitted by Brota Apelao! The #2 Runner Up is Fattallity with the name Galean and Claws with the name Khur'jin. Congratulations to all winners! They can find their special winner's presents in their depot shortly.

Class Updates

Mage
Shaman

- Burst of Speed has had its cooldown reduced to three minutes from five minutes.
- Hailstorm no longer slows down the Shaman or their party.
- Mortal Melody area has been increased to a larger size.
- Bonus +5 Talent Points have been moved from Spirituality to Healing in the talent tree.

Ranger
The physical armor piercing damage of a ranger's arrows against warriors has been buffed. In the new formula a higher level and distance skill increases the amount of damage inflicted.

Marksman

- Arrow Volley has been upgraded to a targeted spell with a secondary area of effect on nearby monsters. It no longer paralyzes targets.
- Spread Shot's damage has been buffed by 20%, and it now has a 50% chance of paralyzing players and monsters. Paralyzed creatures have a visible indicator of their slowed down status.
- The drunken effect of (Strong) Bewilderment now applies to click walking, eliminating a flaw in the previous version of the spell. The duration of bewilderment has been reduced to 20 and 6 seconds respectively due to the newfound strength of the effect.
- Added a +33% distance skill bonus to Critical Continuum with Focus talent selected.
- Piercing Shot now fires an arrow on the target in addition to the current direction. Added a visible indicator to debuffed monsters.

Rogue

- Traps no longer slow down the Rogue or their party. Ice Traps now deal the same amount of damage with only a slight reduction in the edges.
- Barbed Arrow now properly hits players standing on barrels.
- Short Escape now lasts 15 seconds with a cooldown of three minutes.
- Clarified description of Belligerent Focus.

Warrior
Paladin

- Cleave is buffed to inflict the same damage across all tiles.
- Shield Slam now has a chance of stunning a monster for five seconds, disabling them from attacks and casting spells.
- Holy Sword's cooldown has been reduced to 10 seconds.

All Classes

- Each Defending skill level contributes 0.1% Physical Resistance.
- Each 10 Magic Levels contribute 0.5% Magic Resistance.

Full Changelog

New Features
- Updated the game map area to a Widescreen aspect ratio.
- Updated the Character Builder/Outfit Window appearance.
- Updated the Beast Call spell to summon a powerful tank monster.
- Made various updates to class and subclasses as detailed above.
- Added new beginner oriented quests in the Cratai area.
- Added one hour experience boost scrolls to the Premium Shop.
- Added player quick switch for targeted spells such as Heal Friend when right clicking a spell slot.
- Multiple brewable potions can now be consumed at a time to accumulate buffs up to four hours at a time.

Bug Fixes
- Removed monsters spawning in PZ within Path to Cerberus entrance.
- Fixed large bank balance issues in some dialogs.
- Fixed issues with tooltips appearing underneath overlapping windows.
- Fixed issues clicking certain lists in dialogs.
- Fixed Bersund NPC's not talking privately to the player.
- Fixed legacy equipment being dropped in certain quests.

Other Changes
- Added 2% Dodge to Warsong and Ivy Rod.
- Added training grounds to Bersund.
- Removed the staged experience boost for characters below level 50 on Elysium.
- Spells that require more mana are now grayed out for a visual indication.
- Improved navigation in Item Library window.


Sincerely,
Zezenia Staff

notes.title: Path of the Vanguard Update
notes.notes:
https://download.playzezenia.com/images/2024-08-game-update.jpg
A Zezenia Online Game Update has been released. The game client will update automatically. Steam users may need to restart to receive updates.

This update includes the following changes:

Path of the Vanguard

Rumors of an elite army have spread in the remote continent of Tarmell. Those well versed in the area's mysteries and dangers should have no trouble finding the latest front line.

https://download.playzezenia.com/images/2024-11-vanguard-1.jpg

Vanguard Swordsman and Vanguard Ranger are the newest high level monsters for level 500+ players. This Content Drop includes two new spawns (including a Hardcore Hunting Zone) and a new quest with exclusive loot.

https://download.playzezenia.com/images/2024-11-vanguard-2.jpg

Hardcore Dungeons Update

Hard and Hardcore difficulty options have been added to dungeons! Spend one or two dungeon tickets to boost the density, strength & experience of monsters in your dungeon instance for the most valuable hunt. The new difficulties are unlocked after completing a dungeon 25 and 50 times.

https://download.playzezenia.com/images/2024-11-dungeon-difficulty.jpg

The Normal difficulty remains unchanged from the previous version of dungeons. Entrance to normal difficulty dungeons no longer requires Premium items. The new gold entry fee depends on the dungeon's level.

https://download.playzezenia.com/images/2024-11-dungeon-status.jpg

Keep track of remaining time and monsters to be slain using the new Dungeon Status indicator. Make your choices in the Dungeon Window and see the next completion milestone for each dungeon easily.

Full Changelog

- Added Vanguard Swordsman and Vanguard Ranger, two high level mobs for level 500+ players.
- Added Path of the Vanguard quest and Vanguard Hardcore Hunting Zone.
- Added the Dungeon Window with new Hard & Hardcore difficulty levels.
- Added Dungeon Status with remaining timer and monster counter.
- Added keyboard lookup to user interface select boxes.
- Added Tarmellian mackerel & blackfish to Tarmell fishing areas and new continent fish market.
- Fixed missing PvP tiles in certain hardcore hunting zones.
- Tweaked hardcore Geck'Zard spawn.
- Tweaked Gulshan Village Horned Dragon & Warg spawns.
- Barrel throwing cooldowns are now personal to each player only.
- Party members may now be a few tiles off screen to receive shared experience.
- The trapping effect of Hailstorm can no longer be double stacked on tiles.
- Seasonal rewards based on character level can now be withdrawn after rebirth.

Sincerely,
Zezenia Staff

notes.title: Zezenia Online Game Update
notes.notes:
A new Game Update has been released! Steam users may need to restart the app to receive the latest updates.

What's new in this update:

Bag Labels & Auto Loot Organization

Make sense of your inventory by attaching labels & icons to your bags! The new Edit Item dialog allows writing a label on all container items. You may also choose from a selection of icons to distinguish each bag.

https://download.playzezenia.com/images/2024-05-edit-item.png

Keep your automatically looted items in order by configuring one or more containers as Auto Loot bags! Have looted gold, collectibles, gatherables, equipment and others sort themselves into the right bags without any manual effort required.

https://download.playzezenia.com/images/2024-05-bags.png

To get started, hover over a bag to use the new Item Menu, and choose "Edit" to modify that item. Note that Auto Loot bags must be placed directly within the inventory main bag, or the attribute will have no effect.

Bestiary Boost Updates

All boosts purchased from the Bestiary are now personal to each player. Modifier boosts will apply when a monster killed by a boosted player respawns. In addition, the ability to toggle between a one and two hour boost has been added.

https://download.playzezenia.com/images/2024-05-boosts.png

Note: purchased Enraged & Debuff boosts now apply after killing a monster. Once the monster respawns, the boost is applied to that particular spawn only.

Home Training Doll & Brewing Cauldron

https://download.playzezenia.com/images/2024-05-premium-furniture.jpg

The Premium Shop is expanding into home goods beginning with the Home Training Doll and Home Brewing Cauldron! Train your skills & brew potions in the comfort of your own home. Visit the Zezenia Premium Shop online to find the new products.

See you ingame!

Sincerely,
Zezenia Staff

notes.title: Autumn Game Update
notes.notes:
The Zezenia Online August & September Game Updates have been released! Come see what's new in the world of Zezenia:

World Map 2.0

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25580675/caefcc496b53bef7becc7aa865bf534ddebdf638.gif

The new unobscured World Map lets you find your way through Zezenia's continents. Use the Quest Log's integrated Quest Map to discover quests.

New Spawns & Mechanics

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25580675/41f13a917efd4720a3639f762e03834b57abdbfd.png

A dozen new spawns have been added to both the New Continent and existing areas. New mechanics found in some of these spawns include:

Random Spawns rotate between monsters of the same type. Find newly added groups of Lizard Warriors/Guardians/Spellweavers, Mighty Werebears/Mighty Magician Werebears, Devil/Demons and Devil/Soul Devourer/Punishers.

Pillars of Power give a 25% damage buff to nearby monsters marked by a golden aura. Killing a monster within range of a Pillar of Power grants a 7.5% XP boost in exchange. Pillars of Healing heal monsters near them every three seconds.

Fire Traps throw deadly flames on a one, two or three second interval. Don't step on these flames, or you will take significant damage!

Bestiary Improvements

Get a new Loot Boost from the Bestiary! Personal to each player, loot boosts are purchased using collectibles from the monster's loot table. Each boost lasts two hours and has a one hour cooldown.

Save space in your bags with new autoloot controls. Simply click items in the Bestiary to toggle them from being picked up by pets and loot shortcuts.

macOS & Linux support

The Zezenia Online client now supports Mac and Linux/SteamOS platforms! Download the native Mac and Linux client from Steam.

Check the Zezenia website for the full changelog.

Sincerely,
Zezenia Staff

notes.title: Zezenia Online Christmas Update
notes.notes:
Zezenia Online 7.2 is here!

Here's what's new:

Christmas Event

Santa Claus is back in town! Visit Santa in Ellaria for your presents. And be sure to ask if he needs your help with something? Captain Nils in Bersund may also have a Christmas problem.

New Eidos

The beginner city Eidos has received a complete facelift with a focus on helping new players get introduced to the game! A new Beginner Tutorial will help players learn the basic mechanics of Zezenia Online and dispatch them on their adventure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25580675/87940455562d8f80b5003390ae5dea74615938b5.png

If you own a house in Eidos, don't worry: you will find your house items in your depot.

There are also various new quests to discover and solve around Eidos. Be sure to check out the Beginner Island just south of the city, no matter which level you are at!

We will continue to iterate on the beginner experience to make sure that Zezenia is more accessible to newcomers. This is the first step in improving one of the most important parts of the game and acquiring new players!

Party Up

Parties have received a major upgrade! You will now see your companions on the minimap, making sure you never get separated from your friends. Various other improvements are also in place: the party leader can now be reassigned, and party invites can be easily accepted from a popup window.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25580675/a3ed0e1cc48d860d27e07014c469a55178c34fdc.png

Stamina

You will find a new Stamina meter on your character, which refills every 24 hours. Every day, you will receive 50% more experience for approximately an hour of gameplay. And of course, this stacks with Experience Boost Scrolls for the most efficient hunts.

Spells and Balance

To begin correcting the imbalance between classes and subclasses particularly in PvM there have been numerous spell tweaks. Mages will notice new damage patterns on certain spells. Warlock and Shaman PvM damage formulas have been improved.

Rangers have received a long desired AoE spell, Hellish Volley, to liven up those party hunts, as well as reworked formulas for spell damage.

In addition, rangers have received their previous defending skill table back, while the melee skill table for mages has been weakened.

Last but not least, a number of spells have had their cooldown reduced to prevent hunt downtime.

Quality of Life

Many improvements and fixes have been made to everyday functions! Among other things:

- Heal, damage and loot messages are now placed in a new Log chat tab,

- Kill counters are now always visible, and will display the name of the NPC you are working for,

- Currently equipped items will no longer be considered for sale in NPC dialogs,
Items can be dragged directly into hotkey slots,

- The chat box will no longer scroll down on a new message when browsing the backlog,

- Expensive dungeon tickets are no longer consumed for gold dungeons,

- Your health and mana points will now refill on Level Up as a reward for your hard work.

See you ingame! Visit www.playzezenia.com to see the full changelog.
